improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="GDN AI">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition, pricing entry point, and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or other platforms—critical for a B2B audience. Including the free searches hook and starting price builds trust and encourages clicks without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers to complex business and trade questions. Try three free searches today, no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading addresses the key value prop (instant AI answers), highlights the risk-free trial (three free searches), and removes friction by noting no credit card is needed upfront. This combination builds trust while creating a clear path to conversion.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be prompted to select a membership plan to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day and unlocks unlimited access to Gideon, including voice chat and your dedicated members workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the primary conversion point—the transition from free trial to paid membership. It preemptively answers the most common question new visitors have, reduces friction at the paywall moment, and reinforces the low entry price plus annual savings incentive without introducing unverified claims.
